## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff format and lint pass.
- [ ] Frontend production build passes, when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation updated, when applicable.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] Scope authorization is preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, local databases, environment files or build outputs are included.
- [ ] Network activity is bounded and non-destructive.
- [ ] Findings do not disclose credentials or sensitive data.
